title: Simple Foods
description: This mod adds a bunch of good foods to Minecraft!
body:
This mod adds some cool new foods to your Minecraft world! Mess around with them! I'll include a few things in the gallery, but you can skip that part and get straight to downloading!
**The foods in this mod:**
- Yellow, Light Blue, and Red chocolate bars
- Mugs, hot water, and hot cocoa
- Cheese
- Salt
- Tomatoes
- Pizza (slices and pie)
- Vanilla Exctract
- Sprinkles
- Ice Cream
- French fries
- Noodles (and noodles and cheese)
- Hamburgers
  
This mod also adds some blocks, items, and 1 plant: the Vanilla Flower.
The block is the cheese maker, and the items are chocolate bar wrappers, salt, cardboard, a red box, and some more. This mod is mainly about food.
(Again, just like my ice cream mod, I strongly recommend using JEI. It really helps.)
